title: State grants to organizations that already carry warning signs
question: Which organizations flagged elsewhere in this project also received State grants, and how much?
finding: 136 flagged organizations hold State grants on file worth $917.3 million. 26 of them carry something stronger than a lead (a proven or charged case, or an official finding), with $149.7 million in State grants: Healthright 360 (official finding, $62.1 million); Community Partners (official finding, $35.0 million); Brilliant Corners (official finding, $23.6 million); Hunters Point Family (official finding, $5.0 million); Centers For Equity And Success, Inc (official finding, $3.0 million).
how: Every organization on this project's map of warning signs was matched by name to recipients in the California Grants Portal award files (State fiscal years 2022-23 to 2024-25) and in the State corrections board's award tables. The sign shown is the first and strongest one on file for it; the count is how many it carries. Sorted by strength of sign, then by State money.
limits: A State grant is not a warning sign, and most signs here are leads: patterns nobody has ruled on. The State agency may know nothing of a City-level matter and has no duty to. Some State grants are for projects outside San Francisco. Matching is by name; public bodies are left out. The grants file holds only what State agencies chose to post, for three years.
